d: Short, messy ash blonde hair with choppy bangs peaks out from under a dark teal hood. One wide, reddish-brown eye is open while the other is closed in a wink, set on a youthful face with a cheerful expression. The small build is dressed in a dark teal hooded cloak with a gold buckle at the neck, accompanied by a small, orange-furred creature with long ears and a white belly.
